No test is visible in the packet.

terms.meaning: a cut-off number above which something counts as notable
the chance a side wins from the current position
a score for how likely a shot was to go in

sections.name: THRESHOLDS
sections.title: Notable-moment cut-offs
sections.what: Sets the cut-off numbers for cricket, football and F1 stories, such as a win chance swing of 0.15 (15 points) within six legal balls.
sections.why: Each number is named and documented so the owner can judge it.
sections.watch_out: Each number is a judgement call, and changing one changes the public Desk output.

sections.name: PRIORITY, P, plural, gend
sections.title: Priority table and number helpers
sections.what: Ranks story kinds so the most important show first, using a base value plus a scale times the size of the event. Also has helpers that add an s to words and pick the Hindi form for balls.
sections.why: Lets different kinds of story compare on one scale.
sections.watch_out: A kind missing from this table makes building that story fail.

sections.name: possessive
sections.title: Possessive form and title text
sections.what: Adds the possessive mark to a name, with a special form for names ending in s, and builds the English and Hindi titles.
sections.why: Titles use only the story's own values, so no outside facts are added.
sections.watch_out: The English and Hindi title sets must have the same kinds, or a story will have no title in one language.

summary: Holds the numbers and wording rules that decide which moments count as stories for each sport.
purpose: Lets the owner change what the Desk calls a story in one place, with each number explained.
why: The file header says changing a number changes what the Desk calls a story, so each one is named and documented.
how: Lists per-sport thresholds, a priority table that ranks story kinds, and title templates in English and Hindi, each built from the story's own values.
risks: Changing a threshold changes what appears on the Desk. The English and Hindi titles must be kept in step.
debug: If a story is missing or too many appear, check the threshold for its kind and its priority.
